page_title: BAR 2-1 ALA | Barcelona v Alaves 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
90+6' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves), who plants a header just wide of the left post from close range.
90+4' Ander Guevara has a look up and finds Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+3' Kike Garcia (Alaves) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. Alaves force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+2' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ferran Torres (Barcelona) heads on.
87' Alaves are ruled offside.
85' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Andoni Gorosabel will be replaced by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
85' Substitution. Tomas Mendes (Alaves) replaces Antonio Blanco.
83' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Barcelona.
83' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
82' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedri leaves the pitch and Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) comes on.
79' Here is a change. Jon Guridi is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Ianis Hagi (Alaves).
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Kike Garcia (Alaves) is replacing Samu Omorodion.
78' 2 - 1 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) puts the ball into the roof of the net past the outstretched arm of Antonio Sivera.
78' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
77' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a penalty! Barcelona have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
75' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Ruben Duarte (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
75' Raphinha (Barcelona) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.
74' The attendance is 38183.
74' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
73' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

72' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Antonio Sivera makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
71' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
70' Xavi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replacing Joao Felix.
70' It's time for a substitution. Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) comes on in place of Jules Kounde.
70' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Alaves is cautioned for aggressive play. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Barcelona.
68' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the right post.
67' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Joao Felix (Barcelona), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
65' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
63' Xavi has decided to make a change. Raphinha (Barcelona) replaces Fermin Lopez.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Rioja.
62' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
60' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Alaves.
57' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
56' Joao Felix (Barcelona) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.

53' 1 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Jules Kounde showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it into the top left corner – 1:1.
52' A pass by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
51' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals NO PENALTY for Barcelona after a VAR review!
50' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Barcelona! Let's see what he decides.
50' PENALTY APPEAL after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
49' Flag up against Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
48' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt only went low to the middle of the goal, so Antonio Sivera stops it easily.
47' Alaves concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Barcelona have a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
44' Joao Felix (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
42' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Alaves have a free kick.
40' The ball possession at the moment is 70:30.
37' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
36' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
35' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
34' Joao Felix (Barcelona) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
31' Pedri (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonio Sivera intercepts the ball.
30' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the crossbar. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
28' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

26' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets Ferrer no option but to blow his whistle. Barcelona earn a free kick.
22' Surely that's handball by one of the Barcelona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
21' Pedri (Barcelona) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post.
20' A rebound spins to Javi Lopez (Alaves) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post.
19' Some great controlled play and passing from Barcelona. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

17' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Antonio Sivera guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
14' The opposition can't get near Samu Omorodion (Alaves), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.

12' Antonio Sivera was forced into action to thwart Joao Felix (Barcelona). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
11' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
10' What a big chance! Samu Omorodion (Alaves) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
7' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) jumps into a tackle and Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals a foul. A free kick to Alaves.
6' Joao Felix (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Alaves are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' 0 - 1 Goal! Javi Lopez tees up Samu Omorodion (Alaves) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 0:1.

The players are on the pitch and Barcelona will have the kick-off.
